# Toggle pin

Flips a digital output pin once each time its enable turns on.

## Pins and settings

| | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Pin (pin, optional) | Selects the pin at run time; it must be one of the allowed pins. Overrides the **Pin** setting. |
| Device, Pin, Allowed pins | Which device and pin to toggle, and the set of pins the selector may pick. |
| ENO | The toggle succeeded this pass. |

## Behaviour

- It acts on the **rising edge** of the enable, so a one-pass pulse (**Edge**, **Every**, **On event**) toggles once per pulse.
- A pin locked by the board for another purpose cannot be toggled.
